name: Motomiya Akane
source:
15 or 16 years old.
The main character, she is a cheerful, forthright high school freshman. This character's default name is Akane, but the player can pick other names for her. Akane is summoned into the world of Kyou and becomes the Ryuujin no Miko, (Priestess of the Dragon God). She is the only person capable of communicating with the Ryuujin, and with the help of the Hachiyou, she can use the powers of the five elements to defeat the onryou that the Oni Clan has unleashed throughout Kyou.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de] Wikipedia[/url]]
